institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: High perishability of vegetables leading to material and economic loss.
description: A technology for producing ready-to-cook dehydrated vegetables, such as carrot, raw banana, yam, and snake gourd. The process uses a jacketed kettle with agitation, RADD, and a vacuum packaging machine to extend shelf life.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook vegetable mixes • Production of dehydrated ingredients for commercial soups and meals • Processing of shelf-stable emergency food supplies • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural loss reduction centers
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
